prose: A video interview shared on YouTube in which Andrew Ng calls AI extinction fears 'science fiction.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: one of the field's most prominent educators takes the anti-doom position - consistent with his long-standing argument that today's models are far from existential threats and that fear-driven regulation would do more harm than the technology. The interviewer, venue and his specific arguments are unknown from the capture.
highlights: Andrew Ng: AI extinction fears are 'science fiction'
Consistent with his long-standing anti-doom, pro-openness position
Title only; venue and arguments unknown
